entities.name: Tower of the Magistrate
entities.description: White-washed tower at the center of Mercadia City housing the seat of the Chief Magistrate.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: City on Mount Mercadia containing the tower.

entities.name: Chief Magistrate
entities.description: Leader of Mercadia, killed by Orim during the Revolution.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Weatherlight crew leader who bargained with the Magistrate.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Disguised as Takara en-Dal; killed Starke and Griid.

entities.name: Kyren
entities.description: Ruling magistrates of Mercadia, deposed and exiled after the Revolution.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: People the Mercadian armies would be trained to conquer.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship to be repaired and fitted with powerstones.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Arrested after the attack on Rushwood.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Arrested after the attack on Rushwood.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Weatherlight crewmember who struck a new deal.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Weatherlight crewmember who struck a new deal.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Weatherlight crewmember who later killed the Chief Magistrate with a Kyren poison dart.

entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: Attacked the tower in the Revolution and was saved by Orim.

events.summary: Gerrard and Takara (secretly Volrath) petition the Magistrate to drop charges and repair the Weatherlight in exchange for training armies to conquer the Cho-Arrim; Volrath scares the Kyren magistrate and the bargain is accepted.
events.quote: the Chief Magistrate accepted Gerrard's bargain

events.summary: Sisay, Hanna, Orim and Takara-Volrath strike a deal for a stay of execution for Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn in exchange for obtaining the Power Matrix from Saprazzo.
events.quote: They obtained a stay of execution and relocation to better quarters for the three prisoners

events.summary: Volrath brings the blinded Starke into the audience chamber and cuts his throat, revealing his true form.
events.quote: Murdering Starke by cutting his throat, Volrath revealed his true form

events.summary: Volrath kills the lead Kyren Griid over unsatisfactory news about the Ramosians and the Uniter.
During the Revolution, Cho-Manno, Orim and others attack the tower and Orim kills the Chief Magistrate with a Kyren poison dart.
events.quote: Orim killed him using a Kyren poison dart

events.summary: The surviving Kyren are deposed and exiled to the mountains, and the people rule the tower.
events.quote: The surviving Kyren were deposed and exiled to the mountains of Mercadia
